ranked_fixes.whats_wrong: Failed payments: 1.31% in 2026-09 against a target of 0.62%. The gap opened in 2026-07. A change you listed falls in that month (Billing moved to a new Stripe account); check that first.
ranked_fixes.how_computed: $171,950 starting MRR x (1.31% minus target 0.62%) (estimate, one month at September volumes)
ranked_fixes.fix: Check the new Stripe account's revenue recovery settings (Smart Retries and the emails sent when a payment fails), because settings don't carry over from one Stripe account to another; then add a card-update email sequence.

ranked_fixes.whats_wrong: Signup to activated: 31.2% in 2026-09 against a target of 38.6%. The gap opened in 2026-08. A change you listed falls in that month (A new setup wizard replaced the old three-step setup); check that first.
ranked_fixes.how_computed: 1,472 signups x (target 38.6% minus 31.2%) x (29.6% paid if activated minus 3.06% if not) x $38.70 new ARPA (estimate, one month at September volumes)
ranked_fixes.fix: Get new accounts to their first booking within 7 days: compare the new setup wizard with the old three-step setup step by step, and find the step where new accounts now stop before their booking page goes live.

ranked_fixes.whats_wrong: Cancellations and downgrades: 2.62% in 2026-09 against a target of 2.20%. It has been there all six months.
ranked_fixes.how_computed: $171,950 starting MRR x (2.62% minus target 2.20%) (estimate, one month at September volumes)
ranked_fixes.fix: Look at usage in the weeks before each cancellation and add a save step to the cancel flow.

ranked_fixes.whats_wrong: Expansion: 1.58% in 2026-09 against a target of 1.82%. It opened in 2026-09.
ranked_fixes.how_computed: $171,950 starting MRR x (target 1.82% minus 1.58%) (estimate, one month at September volumes)
ranked_fixes.fix: Find where Starter accounts hit the 1-staff limit and show the Growth upgrade there.

ranked_fixes.whats_wrong: Activated to paid: 29.6% in 2026-09 against a target of 30.3%. The gap is under 10% of the target, so no start month is named.
ranked_fixes.how_computed: 459 activated x (target 30.3% minus 29.6%) x $38.70 new ARPA (estimate, one month at September volumes)
ranked_fixes.fix: Review the trial-end emails and the plan choice at the end of the trial.

ranked_fixes.whats_wrong: Visit to signup: 2.72% in 2026-09 against a target of 2.76%. The gap is under 10% of the target, so no start month is named.
ranked_fixes.how_computed: 54,100 sessions x (target 2.76% minus 2.72%) x 11.3% signup to paid x $38.70 new ARPA (estimate, one month at September volumes)
ranked_fixes.fix: Check the web steps before the form, then the form itself.

ranked_fixes.whats_wrong: Referral: 1.46 referred signups per 100 customers in 2026-09 against a target of 1.59 referred signups per 100 customers. The gap is under 10% of the target, so no start month is named.
ranked_fixes.how_computed: 4,236 customers at start x (target 1.59 minus 1.46 referred signups per 100 customers) / 100 x 11.3% signup to paid x $38.70 new ARPA (estimate, one month at September volumes)
ranked_fixes.fix: Ask for referrals at the moment of value, after a business's first bookings.
